body:
45025e7234 pushed (no force), 0 behind origin/main.
Fix: host_recorded_clone now also requires the main that main_for verified to be one THIS host process resolved itself: seat_clone_detect::is_host_main = note_host_main (host git worktree list on a non-clone path) or the process cwd's git root. The marker never feeds that set. cargo_target_dir is accepted only at exactly <main>/target/worktrees/<clone dir>, and only as a real directory (symlink_metadata), never a symlink.
Test (only_the_host_lease_makes_a_host_recorded_clone): the seat builds a fake main in its own target dir, rewrites marker + alternates, and plants a lease there naming an 'elsewhere' target dir. main_for returns Verified(fake), proving the forgery passes every seat-writable check, yet host_recorded_clone is None and neither --settings allowWrite nor os_wrap_rw_paths contains the forged dir. With the anchor removed, the test fails on that assertion. A symlinked target dir gives cargo_target_dir=None and grants nothing.
Consequence: a fresh host process whose cwd is the clone and that never resolved main gets no host-recorded clone. That fails closed: no target-dir grant, and the clone's own .git stays denied for the Edit/Write tools only (Bash git is unaffected).
Gates: check-ci-fast (32), test-touched (776), check-ci-compile ok, clippy (aida-cli-lib + aida-core) clean. Resume-scope note left for TASK-1952.
